description: This file defines the interface and class structure for the RustAdapter plugin in the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations, configuration structures, and method signatures for plugin lifecycle management, invocation, and communication with external components.

classes.name: RustAdapter
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing the Rust::IPlugin interface, managing plugin lifecycle, configuration, and communication.

classes.name: RustAdapter::Config
classes.description: Configuration class for the RustAdapter plugin, managing JSON-based configuration parameters.

methods.name: RustAdapter::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell interface.

methods.name: RustAdapter::AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the plugin.

methods.name: RustAdapter::Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the plugin.

methods.name: RustAdapter::Invoke
methods.description: Handles invocation requests, with different signatures based on build configuration.

methods.name: RustAdapter::GetLibraryPathOrName
methods.description: Static method to get the library path or name based on inputs.

methods.name: RustAdapter::GetAuthToken
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an authentication token.
